prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool to make exactly 2 separate images from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
Full-screen 16:9 game UI mockup of the WORLD MAP screen of a dark fantasy samurai action-RPG (Ghost of Tsushima / Diablo IV / Witcher 3 quality), in exactly the same UI kit as the attached HUD and inventory (Image 1, Image 2): black-red lacquer panels, slim antique copper-gold double borders, small diamond studs, small sakura clusters, red silk tassels, ivory serif text.
Centre of the screen: the planet Yuruma floating in deep violet space (copy the planet from Image 3: teal oceans, pink-violet mana clouds, glowing pink atmosphere). Behind the planet a huge faint pale ring of petrified light in the sky (the "Eye of the Rift"). On the planet: 5 small city markers - red-gold diamond pins with tiny ivory name plaques (one marker highlighted with a soft gold glow and a dotted travel route line to it from the hero marker).
Top centre: an ornate SKY CLOCK - a wide half-disc arc dial of black-red lacquer with copper-gold rim and hour ticks; on the arc three small enamel celestial discs: the golden-white sun "Hoen", the silver moon "Sena" (crescent phase) and the lilac-violet moon "Iru" (half phase); under the dial a small plaque with the date "1 Peach 1047" and the time "Dusk 18:40".
Top left: hero panel (round portrait ring with sakura, name plaque, health bar, gold coin counter) like Image 1. Under it a compact quest tracker panel with a title and two objective lines.
Right side: a selected-city card in the tooltip frame style: city name plaque "Gharn", a small horde emblem, three info rows with small icons (distance, travel time 6 h, danger: high) and two buttons: a crimson lacquer button "Travel" and a dark button "Camp".
Bottom centre: a slim time bar with icon buttons: pause, play travel, "Wait 1 h", "Rest till dawn" (moon icon).
Bottom right: a row of five round icon buttons in copper-gold rings: inventory bag, character, journal scroll, map legend, menu.
Top right: small compass rose and zoom + / - buttons.
Keep the screen uncluttered, panels slim and elegant, lots of space around the planet. No modern sci-fi elements, no strategy-game buttons, no country borders, no flags. Readable short English labels only where described.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition; Image 2: reference for style, shapes and composition; Image 3: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
